fusions.name: Alarm Sting
fusions.desc: A darting sting that deals 3 poison damage, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm Pursuit
fusions.desc: Looses 4 stingers at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 poison damage. Your afflictions on anything they hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Harrying Cloud
fusions.desc: Calls up a swarm for 12 seconds that stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1 second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Forager's Wind
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover restores 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
